data.name: Ravichandra
data.gender_notes: Ravichandra is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Ravi means Sun and Chandra means Moon. This name signifies the Sun God and Moon God in Hinduism. The name Ravichandra carries the meaning “Sun God, Moon God” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Hindu tradition and is also used in Sanskrit, Telugu, Hindi. Parents who choose Ravichandra usually hope their child will grow to embody sun god, moon god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Ravichandra is a name that resonates with the divine energy of the Sun and the Moon. It symbolizes the harmony between light and darkness, knowledge and creativity, and inner and outer worlds. It is believed to bring blessings of wisdom, prosperity, and peace.
data.etymology: Ravichandra belongs to the Hindu linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Sun God, Moon God.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Ravichandra total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

data.spiritual_significance: Ravichandra also symbolizes the dualistic nature of existence, the harmony and balance between the masculine energy (represented by the Sun) and the feminine energy (represented by the Moon). It is a reminder of the importance of balance and harmony in spiritual growth.
